description: This file defines the 'List' feature for comments in an ASP.NET Core application, implementing a request handler that retrieves comments for an article identified by its slug. It handles database access, including related entities, and manages not-found scenarios.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Request object containing the article slug to retrieve comments for.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of fetching comments for the specified article from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that retrieves the article with its comments and author, and returns a CommentsEnvelope; throws a REST exception if the article is not found.
